demand.band: the 10th and 90th percentile of the chosen method's own out-of-sample errors (the log of actual over forecast) at the same local hour, over the 365 days of target days held when the forecast is made

peak.what: the day's highest hourly demand and its local hour; a method's peak is the highest of its own hourly forecasts for the day, and the hour of it; erw is the method chosen for the peak (method), the candidate whose day peaks missed least over the last two years

with_weather_known.what: the regression with the region's observed temperature added (region NW, region_weather_hourly): it reads the day's own weather, so it is not a forecast; it shows how much of the regression's error a perfect weather forecast could remove

operator_filing.what: the operator's day-ahead forecast as filed on Form EIA-930, set against the demand it forecasts: by month, the filed forecast's sum as a percent of the demand's over the hours both hold; a month more than 5 percent from 100 is flagged, a level that far off for a whole month being a break in the filing (a footprint or a definition), not a forecaster's error. shift_mape_last_2_years: the filed forecast's error with its hours moved by -1, 0 and 1 (1: the forecast stamped an hour earlier set against each hour's demand). sound_last_2_years: the scores of the last two years on the unflagged months only. The ERW forecast reads none of this: it judges the comparator

net_demand.what: net demand: the demand less the output of wind and solar (method note section 20). The ERW's is its demand forecast less its wind and solar forecasts (warehouse/predict/wind_solar.py), all made at 20:00 UTC the day before from data through two days before; yesterday is the same hour of the latest whole day read, net; the operator's, where all three of its forecasts are held (Texas, from 27 September 2026), its demand forecast as filed on EIA-930 less ERCOT's wind and solar forecasts published at least 24 hours ahead. nmae_pct: the mean absolute error over the mean net demand of the same hours (a percent of an hour's net demand, which can be near zero, means nothing). No band: the three bands are not combined
net_demand.tomorrow_held: no forecast: region-nw's wind forecast for the target day is not held (no forecast: the last whole day held (2026-11-25) is 3 days before the target day, and this forecast reads exactly two)

price.held: not built: no organised day-ahead market whose hub prices the warehouse holds covers this place
